# docs_audit_report — 2026-07-02

## TL;DR (stranger's 30-second take)
The pitch and the install snippet are genuinely clear, but within 30 seconds a
skeptical stranger hits a headline number that the page itself admits dropped
after an audit ("Repinned from v2 0.9857"), a 12-card Results wall of
unexplained acronyms with several suspiciously perfect scores next to a
"baseline" worse than a coin flip, and a license that says MIT-0 at the top and
Apache 2.0 at the bottom. The page keeps arguing with itself about its own
credibility — most careful strangers close the tab.

## TOP 3 PROBLEMS
1. LICENSE CONTRADICTION — hero badge + <meta> say "MIT-0"; footer says "Apache
   2.0 License". A stranger who checks the license (they do) concludes the
   project can't state its own license.
2. TRUST-KILLING RESULTS GRID — "0.90 AUC (vs 0.125 FoVer baseline)" pits a
   result against a baseline far below random (0.5); "TP rate 0.5 → 1.0" and
   "60/60 attacks" are perfect scores with no sample sizes — all buried in a
   12-card acronym wall (FoVer, CCTU, CRANE, VeriCoT, HalluGuard, SVAMP,
   PRM-BiasBench, EstimationVerifier).
3. HERO LEAKS INTERNAL STATUS — "Repinned from v2 0.9857 after pre-submission
   adversarial audit," "paper-v6," "pending operator-initiated upload," "382
   Completed milestones" make the front door read like a project status board,
   and actively tell the stranger the headline AUROC fell from 0.9857 to 0.9131.
